newsitem.title: USA: Schwab Nov fund flows to top Oct.
newsitem.headline: Schwab Nov fund flows to top Oct.

text.p: Charles Schwab Corp said flows into equity mutual funds topped $895 million through November 22, compared to $764 million for the entire month of October.
Schwab said it saw a sharp drop in aggressive growth flows, with outflows of $5 million versus inflows of $6 million in October.
"This was the first month this year, other than the July correction, when we saw redemptions," a spokeswoman said.
Balanced fund inflows reached $43 million versus $23 million in October.
Growth funds had inflows of $226 million vs $186 million in October, and international funds had inflows of $226 million versus $294 million in October.
